job: Change how an account and a team work, one settings page at a time, beside a side navigation grouped by owner.
purpose: An app screen: a page head, then a split with the subnav on the left (groups split by separators, counts on the right; below 760px of its own width one scrolling strip) and one panel at a time on the right, kept in ?tab=. The team panel is one form with unsaved-changes tracking and a line that says who can edit; locked controls say why and who can unlock them; features are switches in one table grouped by area; deleting the team is confirmed on the page.
useWhen: A product has more than three groups of settings and people move between them often.
Some settings belong to the person and others to the team, and the page has to show which are which and who can change them.
A list of on and off switches needs to stay scannable by area, with some of them locked by plan or role.

avoidWhen.when: One long create or edit form with sections, saved once at the end.
A change reaches many accounts and has to be previewed and committed with a reason.
The page is a record of what changed, not a place to change it.

states.name: ready
states.how: ?state=ready (or no state), or the Demo state band; fd-states data-state="ready". ?tab=account|notifications|team|features|billing|data-sources|connected-apps|advanced picks the panel

states.name: member
